correctness.rationale: Recomputed smoothness elimination gcd(G(y),R(y))=1 in F3[y], with G=y^16(y+1)^5-1 and R=-y^18+y^12-y^4-y^3. An independently written C++ GF(3^m) primitive-modulus gcd enumerator traversed all field elements and verified point counts (13,21,34,73,288,708,2253,6529,19681,58236) for m=1..10. Newton sums reconstruct the first eleven coefficients of L, genus-ten functional equation determines all 21; checker confirms mod23 Rabin irreducibility via gcd for j=4,10 and x^(23^20) ≡x mod L. Nonzero middle coefficient 44020 mod3 yields ordinary p-rank10 and a-number0. Irreducibility over Q precludes base-field isogeny decomposition. Count certificate is COMPLETE for the ten required extension degrees, not a mere sample; no absolute simplicity is claimed.
residual_risks: All extension degree counts rely on independently implemented finite-field algorithms, cross-checked by Newton/functional equation rather than a second full enumeration.
